title: Kubernetes / Logs
description: Container logs from the cluster. Opens on the last 15 minutes because log queries over long ranges are slow.

list.name: namespace
list.label: Namespace
list.description: Search values present in the selected time range (up to 1,000 suggestions).

query.query:
*
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_namespace, namespace) as namespace
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_name, pod) as pod
| coalesce(kubernetes.container_name, container) as container
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_node_name, node) as node
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.container_name>" as service_name
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/name, kubernetes.pod_labels.app, service_name, container) as service_name
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance>" as app_instance
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance, app_instance) as app_instance
| coalesce(output_stream, stream) as stream
| filter namespace:*

list.name: service
list.label: Service
list.description: Search values present in the selected time range (up to 1,000 suggestions).

query.query:
(kubernetes.pod_namespace:in(${namespace}) OR namespace:in(${namespace}))
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_namespace, namespace) as namespace
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_name, pod) as pod
| coalesce(kubernetes.container_name, container) as container
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_node_name, node) as node
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.container_name>" as service_name
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/name, kubernetes.pod_labels.app, service_name, container) as service_name
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance>" as app_instance
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance, app_instance) as app_instance
| coalesce(output_stream, stream) as stream
| filter namespace:in(${namespace}) service_name:*

panels.title: Container logs
panels.description: Choose a namespace, service and time range. Stream and severity start at All. Shows up to 1,000 matching lines; narrow the time range if needed. Open a row's log menu for details and surrounding logs.

targets.expr:
(kubernetes.pod_namespace:in(${namespace}) OR namespace:in(${namespace}))
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_namespace, namespace) as namespace
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_name, pod) as pod
| coalesce(kubernetes.container_name, container) as container
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_node_name, node) as node
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.container_name>" as service_name
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/name, kubernetes.pod_labels.app, service_name, container) as service_name
| format if (kubernetes.pod_name:*) "<kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance>" as app_instance
| coalesce(kubernetes.pod_labels.app.kubernetes.io/instance, app_instance) as app_instance
| coalesce(output_stream, stream) as stream
| unpack_logfmt if (_msg:~"^[[:space:]]*[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*=") fields (level, severity_text, severity, lvl, msg, message, ts, time, timestamp) result_prefix "compat_logfmt."
| coalesce(compat_logfmt.msg, compat_logfmt.message, compat_logfmt.ts, compat_logfmt.time, compat_logfmt.timestamp) as compat_envelope
| coalesce(compat_logfmt.level, compat_logfmt.severity_text, compat_logfmt.severity, compat_logfmt.lvl) as compat_logfmt_candidate
| format if (compat_envelope:*) "<compat_logfmt_candidate>" as compat_logfmt_level
| extract_regexp if (namespace:=iot service_name:=broadsheet container:=app) "^(?P<compat_source_level>warning|error): "
| extract_regexp if (namespace:=printing service_name:=bambuddy container:=app) "^(?:[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2} [0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2},[0-9]{3} )?(?P<compat_source_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL)(?: \\[|:\\s+)" skip_empty_results
| extract_regexp if (namespace:=ai service_name:=mcphub container:=app) "^\\[[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}\\.[0-9]{3}(?:Z|[+-][0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2})\\] \\[(?P<compat_source_level>TRACE|DEBUG|INFO|WARN|ERROR|FATAL)\\] \\[[0-9]+\\] \\[[^\\]]+\\] " skip_empty_results
| coalesce(level, log.level, severity_text, SeverityText, severity, lvl, msg.level, msg.log.level, msg.severity_text, msg.SeverityText, msg.severity, msg.lvl, compat_logfmt_level, compat_source_level) as compat_level
| format "<lc:compat_level>" as compat_level
| replace_regexp ("^\\s+|\\s+$", "") at compat_level
| format "" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(trace,trc)) "trace" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(debug,dbg,verbose)) "debug" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(info,inf,information,informational,notice)) "info" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(warn,wrn,warning)) "warning" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(error,err,severe)) "error" as level
| format if (compat_level:in(critical,crit,alert,emergency,emerg,fatal,panic)) "critical" as level
| delete compat_*
| format if (level:="") "unknown" as level
| filter namespace:in(${namespace}) service_name:in(${service}) stream:in(${stream}) level:in(${level})
